name: coreteller_sign_on
description:
Establish an authenticated CORETELLER session. Invoked on its own, or by the reauthenticate recovery when a longer flow loses its session.
Returns status="success" with typed outputs (none).
May instead return status="business_outcome" with one of these codes. These are legitimate answers, not errors, and retrying will not change them:
  - MEMBER_NOT_FOUND: No member exists for the supplied member number
  - REQUEST_REJECTED: The core rejected the request on validation grounds
  - MEMBER_RESTRICTED: The signed-on operator is not authorised to view this member

operatorId.description: Operator sign-on id for the core banking session.

operatorPassword.description: Operator sign-on password. Never persisted or logged.

name: granite_member_read_savings_balance
description:
Granite State's build of CORETELLER 7.2. Same vendor product, same flow, three cosmetic differences. This artifact is NOT a re-recording: it extends the base capability and patches only what this institution changed, so a fix to the base flow reaches Granite automatically unless it touches one of the points listed below.
Returns status="success" with typed outputs (regularShareBalance: money).
May instead return status="business_outcome" with one of these codes. These are legitimate answers, not errors, and retrying will not change them:
  - MEMBER_NOT_FOUND: No member exists for the supplied member number
  - REQUEST_REJECTED: The core rejected the request on validation grounds
  - MEMBER_RESTRICTED: The signed-on operator is not authorised to view this member

memberId.description: The member number to look up, as printed on the member record.

operatorId.description: Operator sign-on id for the core banking session.

operatorPassword.description: Operator sign-on password. Never persisted or logged.

name: member_open_sub_account
description:
Submit a new share sub-account request for an existing member and return the confirmation reference the core issues. Writes to the core: the submit step requires a human decision.
Returns status="success" with typed outputs (confirmationReference: string).
May instead return status="business_outcome" with one of these codes. These are legitimate answers, not errors, and retrying will not change them:
  - MEMBER_NOT_FOUND: No member exists for the supplied member number
  - REQUEST_REJECTED: The core rejected the request on validation grounds
  - MEMBER_RESTRICTED: The signed-on operator is not authorised to view this member
This capability writes to a system of record and will pause for a human operator to approve before it completes.

memberId.description: The member number to look up, as printed on the member record.

operatorId.description: Operator sign-on id for the core banking session.

productCode.description: Share product code for the new sub-account, e.g. S06.

operatorPassword.description: Operator sign-on password. Never persisted or logged.

name: store_add_to_cart_and_review
description:
Sign in to the Swag Labs storefront, add a named product to the cart, and drive checkout to the order review page, returning the order total.
Returns status="success" with typed outputs (orderTotal: money).
May instead return status="business_outcome" with one of these codes. These are legitimate answers, not errors, and retrying will not change them:
  - USER_LOCKED_OUT: The account is locked and cannot sign in
  - CREDENTIALS_REJECTED: The storefront rejected the supplied credentials
